verdict.rationale: Persona's docs confirm a Government ID Verification capability that checks whether a person holds a genuine government-issued ID. They also show it can be combined with selfie and liveness checks. Nothing in the pack names specific countries or document types, and no published supported list appears. Missing for 10: a published list of supported countries, coverage of passports, national IDs, driver licenses and residence permits, and independent corroboration of breadth.
